purpose: Single-phase 3D CFD reference data for operator-learning and LLM-assisted configuration experiments.

mesh_gate.rationale: Tetrahedral meshes can trigger the strict determinant heuristic; acceptance additionally requires a stable solver smoke test and mass-balance audit.

evaluation.primary_accuracy: normalized rollout MSE over a preregistered horizon
evaluation.test_policy: test_ID and test_OOD stay locked until model and hyperparameter protocol are frozen

storage_policy.raw_openfoam: PERUN only; delete non-retained time directories after verified export
storage_policy.local: manifests, summaries, figures and compressed representative videos only

scope_exclusions: moving or suddenly inserted obstacles (separate intervention extension)
bulk generation before representative mesh and solver gates pass
